facts.business: Suryoday Small Finance Bank provides inclusive banking services including microfinance, MSME financing, retail banking, housing loans, loan against property, and commercial vehicle finance to underserved segments across India.

auditor.name: M/s. Tushar Shridharani & Associates LLP (Secretarial Auditor); Joint Statutory Auditors not named in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: No qualification, reservation, adverse remark or disclaimer given by the Auditors in their Report. Also, no offence of fraud was reported by the Joint Statutory Auditors under Section 143(12) of the Act.

key_risks: Challenges in Micro Finance segment in line with industry trends
Below-normal and uneven monsoon for FY27 influenced by evolving El Niño conditions, which may moderate kharif output and impact rural incomes and demand
Potential implications for credit growth and asset quality due to weaker monsoon
Food inflation remaining elevated due to rainfall variability and extreme weather events
Geopolitical tensions and rising concerns over instability and energy prices, including shutdown of Strait of Hormuz disrupting global trade flows and energy supply chains
Pressure on Indian Rupee from global uncertainties
Tight liquidity conditions leading to increased competition for deposits
